verdict.rationale: The only sandbox-relevant evidence is that the Facilitator's supported network table includes Base Sepolia (a testnet) alongside mainnet networks, implying test-network settlement is possible, but there is no dedicated sandbox guide, test wallet/test-mode documentation, or explicit instructions for developers to isolate test transactions from production data. missing for 10: dedicated sandbox/testnet onboarding docs, test API keys or mock facilitator mode, explicit guidance on isolating test payments from production accounting.
